payload.name: Each pair of doors will have one of four symbols
payload.description: the blue goobbue, red demon, the light green dragon, and the dark green moth. When a pair of doors with matching symbols are opened, the party will be pulled into one of the doors and transported to the other door with the same symbol. During transportation, the party will be inflicted with Voidbound which prevents the use of any actions but become invincible. After transportation, the party will inflicted with one stack of Diabolic Curse, which increases damage taken. The pair of doors used for transportation will disappear after transportation. The symbols will only appear at the start of the fight and during transportation, after which they will disappear. Doors can be marked with 25px|link= signs to keep track of pairs.

payload.name: Ruinous Omen
payload.description: a very hard-hitting roomwide AoE that will inflict three stacks of Diabolic Curse. The damage from this spell can be fatal to players with less sufficient gear, or are not topped from healing. The party should have the effects of Voidbound given during transportation between doors to avoid multiple stacks of Diabolic Curse and avoid the damage from Ruinous Omen. The boss will gain Noctoshield, a buff that grants immunity to stun during the cast.

payload.name: Intermission Phase
payload.description: At around 75%, 50%, and 25% HP, the boss will start circling the room's outer perimeter and become un-targetable, dealing damage to players within its path. One Illuminati Sniper and one Illuminati Glider adds will spawn. A few seconds later, it will launch a massive amount of bombs that cover the entire area. payload.name: Lunar Cry
payload.description: Long-duration cast that will instantly knock out any players not hiding behind an icicle. The first time Lunar Cry is cast, you can hide behind any of the four icicles to block the attack. After the first Lunar Cry, you must hide behind the icicle which stays blue. The other three of the four icicles will start blue, but turn pink in color and then shatter. As soon as Lunar Cry finishes, the icicle will explode in a circular AoE, freezing nearby players for 10 seconds and applying damage over time. Either stand far enough away from the icicle while also remaining out of sight, or stay near the icicle and be prepared to move quickly after the cast finishes.
